item: GET side effects with data: the GETs that answered 4xx on an empty database are driven on a seeded corpus and planted artifacts under the same monitors
summary: Seeds one row of each kind (source in its group with metadata, article, law document and watched wiki page with two revisions each, a Wikidata item and a Place, commodity prices, an edition, an import report, a custody entry) and plants by hand the artifacts a POST job leaves (all-diagnostics archive, keyword-parts set, ai-check, model-bench, release-run, fold and re-index reports, a region pbf). Drives 67 of the 74 GETs that answered 4xx on an empty DB (66 of 73 Core-only) under the first file's socket/thread/program/file/SQL-write/data_version monitors and tables; 7 are not driven with a reason read from the handler. Ten driven routes still answer from their empty branch (listed in _EMPTY_BRANCH). One finding: three diagnostics downloads (all-job/download, all-job/volumes/{name}, keywords/parts/{set}/{name}) append to diagnostics/runs.jsonl and are not cross-site guarded; recorded in _ROUTES_WITH_DATA and routed. The first file gains an identity check that every route it finds answering 4xx is covered here. The commodity correlation route is profile-dependent (74 named on full, 73 Core-only). Also extracts _file_and_thread_problems and adds the lesson on two-profile route floors and walk order.
